visual_observations_parent.nyuv2_0005: Parent and S shapes are nearly unchanged; whiteboard remains missed,table and chair contour shifts are slight. Depth .0639 to .0623 improves modestly while F1 .332 to .322 decreases. No new structure recovered.
visual_observations_parent.nyuv2_0598: S removes much of the cyan right tabletop edge retained by parent;F1 .505 to .425 falls visibly despite depth .0544 to .0521 improving. Fine legs remain red/missed. This is a clear local depth-value versus boundary-detection tradeoff.
visual_observations_parent.nyuv2_1440: S adds yellow fragments along the thin chair post and some cyan matches shift;F1 .532 to .495 declines. Broad chair/counter error is almost unchanged,AbsRel .1038 to .1035. Best/final images match exactly.
visual_observations_parent.nyuv2_0226: Parent and S retain similar person/column contours,false branches and missing fine furniture. S loses a small cyan segment around the head/shoulder, F1 .501 to .492;depth .1745 to .1770 slightly worsens.
visual_observations_parent.nyuv2_0246: Very small numerical and contour changes: false ceiling and missing shelf/table remain;F1 .493 to .492. Depth .1769 to .1725 improves slightly without clear new boundary recovery.
visual_observations_parent.nyuv2_0080: S loses a short cyan upper shelf/post segment and shortens some central matches;F1 .493 to .437. Depth stays about .0810. Most fine structures remain missed. This is not an all-zero or constant prediction.

visual_observations_increment.nyuv2_0005: S200 to S300 changes depth .0644 to .0623 with nearly same silhouette;F1 .340 to .322. Whiteboard missed in both;both F1 below B0.
visual_observations_increment.nyuv2_0598: Right tabletop cyan is substantially lost at300,F1 .524 to .425;AbsRel .0489 to .0521 also worsens, with300 worse thanB0 .0481. Fine legs remain missing.
visual_observations_increment.nyuv2_1440: Fewer left-chair false fragments but additional thin central-post unmatched predictions at300;F1 .512 to .495. Depth .1050 to .1035 slightly better but both worse thanB0 .0882.
visual_observations_increment.nyuv2_0226: Person/column and parts of the foreground metric error decrease, .2153 to .1770;F1 .507 to .492 declines with contour shifts. Both greatly improve global depth versusB0, but missed furniture and false branches remain.
visual_observations_increment.nyuv2_0246: Broad wall/shelf error becomes slightly darker, .1875 to .1725,still worse thanB0 .1129. Foreground cyan a little less continuous,F1 .501 to .492;false ceiling persists.
visual_observations_increment.nyuv2_0080: S300 loses cyan upper-post matches and has brighter wall error;depth .0675 to .0810 and F1 .533 to .437 both worse thanS200, though both better thanB0 .0986/.162. More training data does not improve every fixed image.

interpretation: This first S300 seed is a near-parent correction with lower boundary-band error and worse thresholded boundary F1. The observed terminal best is not evidence that further training would improve or worsen; the prescribed early stop is retained.
